request.idea: Maya finds a lonely star that is scared to go back into the sky.

bible.title: Maya’s Sky Song
bible.userIdea: Maya finds a lonely star that is scared to go back into the sky.
bible.premise: When maya finds a lonely star among the grass, its scared silence keeps it earthbound. A steady song can guide it back into the sky.
bible.hook: A tiny light blinks beneath the grass whenever Maya hums.
bible.goal: Help the star return to the sky without losing its company.
bible.centralProblem: The star fears being alone above the garden and needs reassurance throughout its return.
bible.stakes: Without a steady companion’s song, the star will remain beneath the grass.
bible.motif: A soft hum answered by a steady glow.

locations.name: the moonlit garden
locations.visualIdentity: Tall soft grass beneath an open violet sky, with pale moonlight along the edges.

entities.name: the star
entities.identity: A small five-pointed light with a soft face. Hearing a companion hum steadies its glow and lets it float upward; silence makes it settle.
entities.state: Returned to the sky above the garden, shining steadily.

expresses.shows: She parts the grass where a blink answers her humming.

beats.action: Maya hums beside the grass, and a hidden light answers. She parts the blades to find its source.
beats.visualFocus: A small golden blink near Maya’s yellow cardigan.
beats.compositionIntent: Place Maya low beneath a broad, restful sky.
beats.textPurpose: Connect Maya’s humming with the hidden light.

characters.clothing: yellow cardigan, white shirt, blue skirt
yellow cardigan, white shirt, blue skirt

entities.state: Hidden in the grass, blinking in response to Maya’s humming.

expresses.shows: She hums again and watches the light lift.

beats.action: The star whispers, “Up there, I’ll be alone.” Maya hums again; its glow steadies, and it lifts.
beats.visualFocus: The star rising just above the grass.
beats.compositionIntent: Bring Maya’s listening face level with the hovering star.
beats.textPurpose: Reveal the star’s fear and establish how humming helps.

expresses.shows: She stays beneath the rising light and offers reassurance.

beats.action: Maya hums until the star floats above her head. She stops to promise, “I’ll stay here.”
beats.visualFocus: Maya looking upward as her humming stops.
beats.compositionIntent: Frame Maya below the star, with generous sky above.
beats.textPurpose: Show a well-meant promise interrupting the help that works.

expresses.shows: She kneels and tests her hum instead of searching blindly.

beats.action: The quiet star dims and settles out of sight. Maya kneels and hums; a glow answers beneath the grass.
beats.visualFocus: A warm patch of light beside Maya’s knees.
beats.compositionIntent: Show grass concealing the star until its glow returns.
beats.textPurpose: Make the interrupted song cause a different problem and recovery.
beats.pageTurnHook: Can Maya keep the song going all the way?

beats.visualFocus: The star reaching its place overhead.
beats.compositionIntent: Open the full sky above Maya and the ascending light.
beats.textPurpose: Resolve the return through the uninterrupted humming established earlier.
